# Generated content — do not review

The following is generated by Weaver via `make generate-all` and must not be
hand-edited:

- the entire `schema-snapshot/registry.yaml` file
- everything under `docs/registry/`
- the auto-generated tables inside `docs/gen-ai/*.md` (the surrounding
  hand-written prose in these files is normal content — review it as usual)

Do not review, comment on, or suggest changes to the generated content above.
Any concern about it should instead be raised against the model sources that
produced it (`model/<namespace>/*.yaml`).
